name: Hameed Ibrahim
tagline: I build enterprise-grade software — from core banking systems to AI-powered applications.
bio: Software Developer with 4 years of experience building enterprise banking applications across Payments, Trade Finance, AML, and Risk Management. Currently at The Saudi Investment Bank, working on SWIFT ISO 20022 migration and real-time sanction screening. I also build AI-enabled solutions, integrating LLM APIs and MCP workflows into production products.

about.profileText: Software Developer with 4 years of experience building enterprise banking applications. I specialize in Java microservices, full-stack development, and banking domain expertise spanning Payments, Trade Finance, AML, and Risk Management. I'm passionate about building reliable, scalable systems and integrating AI into production workflows.
about.skillsText: I've worked across the full stack — from enterprise Java backends to Angular/React frontends — and I'm comfortable in the cloud, on the command line, and wiring up LLM APIs.

experience.description: Working on Payments Manager & Trade Finance modules for enterprise core banking operations using Java, Spring Frameworks, IBM MQ, SQL Server, IBM Db2, and IBM WebSphere. Built microservices for the SWIFT MT→MX ISO 20022 (CBPR+) migration and engineered real-time sanction screening by integrating an external Watchlist system via AMLS, delivering an end-to-end compliance solution from concept to production.

Built and maintained CEAM Attestation & Workflow and Product Risk Monitoring applications for Citi's enterprise-wide risk inventory using Java, Spring, Kafka, Redis, and Angular. Boosted app responsiveness by 40% via async/batch processing, hardened security with JWT auth and RBAC, reached 85%+ SonarQube coverage, and accelerated delivery 2× with CI/CD pipelines on Jenkins and OpenShift.

Built a serverless EV dashboard (Fossil) on AWS using Next.js, featuring Vehicle Tracking, Remote Monitoring, OTA updates, and Payment Gateway integration. Architected the data pipeline from raw vehicle telemetry into actionable insights using AWS EC2, DynamoDB, API Gateway, and Lambda Functions.
Led a team of 50 student designers and developers as president of NIT Trichy's official design club — managing budgets, member activities, and club operations across multiple large-scale projects.
Led a team of 7 for Aaveg '20, the annual cultural and sports fest of NIT Trichy — overseeing all design deliverables and web operations for the event.
